    simpa [h₁] using (isOpenMap_fst : IsOpenMap (Prod.fst : X × Y → X))

  have hcont1 : Continuous π₁ := by
    simpa [h₁] using (continuous_fst : Continuous (Prod.fst : X × Y → X))
  have hcont2 : Continuous π₂ := by
    simpa [h₂] using (continuous_snd : Continuous (Prod.snd : X × Y → Y))
  have hsurj1 : Function.Surjective π₁ := by
    rw [h₁]
    intro x
    obtain ⟨y⟩ := ‹Nonempty Y›

    intro y

    (∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt g (deriv g x) x) →
    Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => deriv g x) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, C ≤ x → |g (x + 1) - g x| ≤ 1) :
  ∃ f : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous f ∧
    (∀ x : ℝ, ∀ y : Y, F (x, y) = f x) ∧

    (∀ n, n < N → n ≠ 0 → (A n ∩ ⋃ k < n, A k).Nonempty) →
    IsPathConnected (⋃ k < N, A k) := by
  revert hN
  induction N with
  | zero =>
      intro hN
      omega
  | succ N ih =>
      intro hN hA hPred
      by_cases hN0 : N = 0
      · subst N
        have heq : (⋃ k < Nat.succ 0, A k) = A 0 := by
          ext x
          constructor
          · intro hx
            rcases mem_iUnion.1 hx with ⟨k, hx⟩
            rcases mem_iUnion.1 hx with ⟨hk, hx⟩
            have hk0 : k = 0 := by omega

          apply ih (by omega)

          hPred N (Nat.lt_succ_self N) (by omega)

theorem bounded_shift_forward_difference
  {f : ℝ → ℝ} {h B : ℝ}
  (hh0 : 0 ≤ h) (hhB : h ≤ B)
  (hfd : DifferentiableOn ℝ f (Ioi 0))
  (hf : Tendsto (deriv f) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
  Tendsto (fun x => f (x + h) - f x) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  by_cases hzero : h = 0
  · subst h
    simpa using (tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : ℝ => (0 : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 0))
  · have hpos : 0 < h := lt_of_le_of_ne hh0 (Ne.symm hzero)
    refine Metric.tendsto_atTop.2 ?_
    intro ε εpos
    have hB1 : 0 < B + 1 := by linarith
    have hδpos : 0 < ε / (B + 1) := div_pos εpos hB1
    have hderiv_small : ∀ᶠ y : ℝ in atTop, |deriv f y| < ε / (B + 1) := by
      have hball := hf.eventually (Metric.ball_mem_nhds (0 : ℝ) hδpos)
      refine hball.mono ?_
      intro y hy
      simpa [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq, abs_sub, sub_zero] using hy

    refine ⟨max N 1, ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    have hxN : N ≤ x := le_trans (le_max_left N 1) hx
    have hx1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ x := le_trans (le_max_right N 1) hx
    have hxpos : 0 < x := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hx1
    have hxlt : x < x + h := lt_add_of_pos_right x hpos
    have hsubset_cc : Icc x (x + h) ⊆ Ioi (0 : ℝ) := by
      intro y hy
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hxpos hy.1
    have hsubset_oo : Ioo x (x + h) ⊆ Ioi (0 : ℝ) := by
      intro y hy
      exact lt_trans hxpos hy.1

    have hone : Nat.choose n k = 1 ↔ k = 0 ∨ n = k :=
      Nat.choose_eq_one_iff
    constructor
    · intro h
      have hcases : k = 0 ∨ n = k := hone.mp (hsymm.symm.trans h)
      rcases hcases with hk0 | hnk
      · omega
      · exact hnk.symm
    · intro h
      subst k
      simp
  have hbridge :
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, j * Nat.choose n j) =
          (n * 2 ^ (n - 1)) * Nat.choose n (n - k) ↔
        Nat.choose n (n - k) = 1 := by
    constructor
    · intro h
      have hmul :
          (n * 2 ^ (n - 1)) * 1 =
            (n * 2 ^ (n - 1)) * Nat.choose n (n - k) := by
        calc
          (n * 2 ^ (n - 1)) * 1 = n * 2 ^ (n - 1) := by simp
          _ = ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, j * Nat.choose n j := hsum.symm
          _ = (n * 2 ^ (n - 1)) * Nat.choose n (n - k) := h
      have hone : 1 = Nat.choose n (n - k) :=
        Nat.mul_left_cancel hnorm hmul
      exact hone.symm
    · intro h
      rw [hsum, h]
      simp
  have hcoupled :
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, j * Nat.choose n j) =
          (n * 2 ^ (n - 1)) * Nat.choose n (n - k) ↔ k = n :=
    hbridge.trans hcomp
  exact hcoupled
